items.pos: n. 故障 | v. 失靈
items.colloc: mechanical malfunction 機械故障 | report a malfunction 回報故障
items.distinct: breakdown 損壞停止運作 | flaw 瑕疵
ex: The device experienced a sudden malfunction.
該裝置發生了突發性故障。
Staff reported a malfunction in the printer.
員工回報了印表機的故障。
Constant use may cause system malfunction.
持續使用可能會導致系統失靈。

items.colloc: defective product 有瑕疵的產品 | identify defective items 識別瑕疵品
items.distinct: faulty 有毛病的 | deficient 不足的
ex: We must recall all defective merchandise.
我們必須召回所有瑕疵商品。
The customer returned the defective unit.
客戶退回了有缺陷的裝置。
She found a defective part inside.
她在裡面發現了一個瑕疵零件。

items.colloc: replace the item 更換項目 | replace the battery 更換電池
items.distinct: substitute 替代 | exchange 交換
ex: The company will replace the broken unit.
公司將會更換那個損壞的裝置。
We need to replace the missing parts.
我們需要更換缺失的零件。
They decided to replace the old equipment.
他們決定更換老舊設備。

items.colloc: dissatisfied customer 不滿的客戶 | express dissatisfaction 表達不滿
items.distinct: discontent 不滿足的 | disgruntled 不悅的
ex: The client remains dissatisfied with our service.
客戶對我們的服務仍感到不滿。
Many dissatisfied users left negative reviews.
許多不滿意的用戶留下了負評。
We strive to assist dissatisfied shoppers.
我們致力於協助不滿意的消費者。

items.colloc: offer an apology 致歉 | accept an apology 接受道歉
items.distinct: excuse 藉口 | regret 後悔
ex: The manager offered a sincere apology.
經理表達了誠摯的歉意。
They sent an apology regarding the delay.
他們發出了一封關於延誤的道歉信。
An official apology was issued today.
官方今日發布了正式道歉。

items.colloc: follow the guidelines 遵循準則 | establish guidelines 建立方針
items.distinct: instruction 指示 | standard 標準
ex: Employees should follow these updated guidelines.
員工應該遵循這些更新的準則。
The manual provides clear usage guidelines.
手冊提供了清晰的使用指導方針。
We must adhere to safety guidelines.
我們必須遵守安全準則。

items.colloc: escalate a complaint 將投訴升級 | escalate the situation 使情況惡化
items.distinct: increase 增加 | intensify 加劇
ex: Please escalate this issue to management.
請將此問題升級給管理層處理。
The conflict began to escalate rapidly.
衝突開始迅速升級。
They decided to escalate the support request.
他們決定將支援請求升級。

items.colloc: service restoration 服務恢復 | full restoration 完全修復
items.distinct: recovery 復原 | repair 修理
ex: The restoration of power took hours.
電力恢復耗費了數小時。
We completed the restoration of the file.
我們完成了檔案的修復。
System restoration is currently in progress.
系統恢復作業目前正在進行中。

items.colloc: rectify a mistake 糾正錯誤 | rectify the situation 改善情況
items.distinct: correct 改正 | amend 修改
ex: We must rectify these errors immediately.
我們必須立即糾正這些錯誤。
The team worked to rectify the problem.
團隊致力於糾正該問題。
Steps were taken to rectify the imbalance.
當局採取了步驟以糾正失衡。
